Name: Yandere Elliott Seasonal Portraits (Speremint Edition)
Author: speremint
Description:
The Yandere!Elliott mod is incredible, and I heavily recommend checking it out.

I received permission from @NinTheCactus69 to publish my take on their Yandere Elliott portraits~ I'd heavily recommend going to check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14270]their original mod[/url] if my style isn't quite your tea.

Please, [b]please [/b]read the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8807]original page[/url] of the Yandere!Elliott mod if you have potential triggers.

To install this mod, downlaod and extract into your "Mods" folder. If you are using seasonal portraits, go into your mod config folder and disable revisions to Elliott or else this mod won't work.

Go give @NinTheCactus69 some love as they worked their ass off on making these additional sprite and portrait edits, as well as bug fixing the original mod! I can't thank them enough for their work.

[b]CREDITS:[/b]
[b]@ninthecactus69 [/b]for the original edits to the portraits + bug fixes on dialogue
[b]@KatherineC4 [/b]for the original Yandere Elliott mod
[b]@Kxgarashii [/b]for the English translation of the Yandere mod
[b]@Poltergeist [/b]for Seasonal portraits + Character sprites
